What makes a good prompt for monitoring? We find that 1. providing a reasoning structure for the model is by far the most important component, followed by 2. severity rubric and 3. worked examples Everything else barely matters (in our setting).

Interestingly, we find that providing a reasoning structure still makes a difference when we use a lot of native reasoning on top. This suggests that there is some advantage in explaining what to look out for in the transcript and how to reason through it.

We also find that compressing the prompt, i.e. summarizing components, is much more effective than cutting components or parts of components. For example, it is more important to briefly describe multiple components than to describe the most important component in detail.
